lines.zh: 我四脚着地，慢慢压过沙地。
lines.en: I bear down on the sand on four legs.
The plates along my back bob with each step.
Two pairs of long spikes tip my tail.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但体重压得地面响。
lines.en: Not fast, but my weight makes the ground speak.

lines.zh: 侏罗纪的灌木在我腿边断开。
lines.en: Jurassic brush snaps at my legs.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，边走边吃。
lines.en: I keep my head low and graze as I go.
I follow the line of the hills.
Every step leaves a deep print.
I turn and my tail sweeps the grass.
I lift a foreleg over a fallen log.

lines.zh: 我的骨板在阳光下发烫。
lines.en: My plates grow hot in the sun.

lines.zh: 我朝稀树草原的方向走。
lines.en: I head for the savanna.
I stop and look back.

lines.zh: 地面被我的爪子划出沟。
lines.en: My claws score the soil.
I shift under the shade.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，草叶飞起来。
lines.en: I flick my tail and grass flies.

lines.zh: 我站着，骨板一片片竖着。
lines.en: I stand, my plates all standing up.
Wind passes through the gaps in my plates.
I chew grass slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，听远处的响声。
lines.en: I raise my head toward a distant sound.
My tail hangs relaxed.
I shift my weight to my hind legs.
My back plates are hot from the sun.

lines.zh: 骨板投下的影子像一排栅栏。
lines.en: My plates cast shadows like a fence.
I lower my head and sniff the ground.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的背板，有声音。
lines.en: Wind through my back plates makes a sound.
I hear a young one in the distance.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，骨板正对着你。
lines.en: I raise my head, plates toward you.
The plates on my back are hot from the sun.

lines.zh: 莫里森组的骨板，圈住这片地。
lines.en: Morrison bone plates ring this ground.
I lift my tail slightly.
Are you looking at my plates?
I dip my head once. That's a warning.
I plant my forelegs.

lines.zh: 看什么？我的尾刺可不长眼。
lines.en: What are you looking at? My tail spikes don't aim carefully.
I bellow and my body sinks.
One plate is knocked askew.
A plate has split and blood seeps out.
Blood runs down my plates.
I curl my tail in.
My hind legs cannot hold my weight.

lines.zh: 背板挡了一下，可还是疼。
lines.en: A plate took the blow, but it still hurts.
The blow caught my flank.
Those leaves look all right.

lines.zh: 你举着的那丛，是给我的？
lines.en: Is that clump for me?

lines.zh: 蕨叶的味道，让我挪过去。
lines.en: The smell of fern draws me over.
I lower my head and take half the clump.
Leaves fall from my mouth.
Don't stand behind my tail.

lines.zh: 我吃东西的时候不设防。
lines.en: I'm unguarded when I eat.
That's a few mouthfuls at most.
I lower my head and take a bite of fern.
Bring more.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的侧腹，被弹开。
lines.en: You hit my flank and bounce off.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，尾巴摆了摆。
lines.en: I sway and my tail swings.
You ran into my back plates.
You end up sitting on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的骨板刮到了你的肩。
lines.en: My plates scrape your shoulder.
I shift a step aside.
My tail isn't to be trifled with.
Watch where you walk.
A kin is over the rise.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过去，骨板晃着。
lines.en: I walk over, plates swaying.
One swing of my tail spikes draws blood.
I curl my tail around.
The young are behind the brush.
I'll guard them.
This land can feed them.

lines.zh: 伴侣就在坡下，别去打扰它。
lines.en: My mate is down the slope; don't disturb it.
I lower my head and take a clump.

lines.zh: 我用前腿按住一根枝条。
lines.en: I pin a branch with a foreleg.
Too thick to bite through.
I scoop it up with my beak.
I dropped it; I'll lower my head again.
This tastes of soil.
That fern frond is mine. Put it down.

lines.zh: 你捡起石子，我立刻警惕起来。
lines.en: You pick up a stone, and I'm instantly on guard.
Something's coming close.
I raise my head and my plates lift.
My tail points at it.
I swing my spikes round.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我抬起尾。
lines.en: Too close; I lift my tail.
I raise my spikes as high as they go.
I won't yield this ground.
You've stepped over the line. Back away.
It circles me.
I turn with it.
My spikes stay aimed at it.
It probes closer.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，把尾刺亮出来。
lines.en: I turn sideways and show my tail spikes.
The young one calls.
It's still hesitating.

lines.zh: 尾刺已经对准你的方向。
lines.en: My tail spikes already point your way.
Its footsteps are heavy.
I turn with its direction.
I whip my tail and the spikes sweep.

lines.zh: 这一下划开了皮，血往外冒。
lines.en: The cut opens and blood wells.
I ram with my body.
I'm shoved half a step off line.
I raise the spikes again.
It retreats; I follow one step.
I've held.
The young are still behind me.
Come again and I'll strike again.
I settle back into place.
I shoulder into it sideways.
The spikes pass through and the grass snaps.
I rise out of the brush.
Soil clings to my plates.
I test the ground.
Savanna spreads out before me.

lines.zh: 我的尾刺碰了一下树干。
lines.en: My spikes tap a trunk.
Kin in the distance.
I graze as I go.
My plates stand out in the sun.
This will do for a home.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，第一次闻到这片草。
lines.en: I raise my head to the first smell of this grass.
I spread my spikes out.

lines.zh: 草烧起来，火爬上我的腿。
lines.en: The grass burns and fire climbs my legs.

lines.zh: 我这么重摔下去，地面都裂了。
lines.en: A body this heavy cracks the ground.

lines.zh: 水淹过我的头，我拼命划。
lines.en: Water covers my head; I thrash.
The blast shoves me aside.
An arrow finds the gap between my plates.

lines.zh: 光压住我的身体，动不了。
lines.en: Light pins my body and I can't move.
Hunger makes even my plates feel heavy.
Lightning runs down my plates.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没了，我直坠下去。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; I drop straight down.
